rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something boldly and confidently.

example.english: They boldly raised an objection in the meeting.
example.traditional: 佢大膽噉喺會議入面提出反對意見。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daai6 daam2 gam2 hai2 wui6 ji5 jap6 min6 tai4 ceot1 faan2 deoi3 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is specifically on self-confidence rather than daring or fearlessness.

example.english: You boldly introduced yourself to everyone and spoke very clearly.
example.traditional: 你有信心咁向大家介紹自己，講得好清楚。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 seon3 sam1 gam2 hoeng3 daai6 gaa1 gaai3 siu6 zi6 gei2 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this when someone proceeds boldly without holding back, especially before an action such as doing or saying something.

example.english: Go ahead and boldly say what you think.
example.traditional: 你放膽講出你嘅諗法啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 fong3 daam2 gong2 ceot1 nei5 ge3 nam2 faat3 laa1
